scope: The 276-system categorical known-truth mechanism programme in PR #27.
disclosure: Before this stop record, two successful first-execution batch artifacts (54 systems total) were inspected for implementation sanity. They showed the factorization identity was numerically exact and provided partial directional information. The full v0.5 aggregate was not available or opened.
stop_rule: After the artifact-backed v0.5/v0.5.1 balance-normalized aggregate is recorded, no additional generator, estimator, target, state-balance transformation, subgroup filter, or parameter-grid search may be used to strengthen the primary mechanism claim on these same 276 systems.
allowed_after_close: correct implementation or provenance errors without changing scientific thresholds
figures and prose that report already-frozen analyses
formal algebraic derivations of already-used statistics
independent replication on a new dataset or independently frozen phylogenetic geometries
future methods explicitly labeled as separate work and not used to reclassify the primary result
prohibited_after_close: execute the older alternative-estimator v0.4 route to rescue a weak v0.5 result
search new estimators on the 276 systems
extend Mk2 or OU parameter grids after seeing final outcomes
change the rho=0.15 or Delta_rank=0.30 targets
drop geometry-matched systems based on their v0.5 outcome
publication_consequence: The paper must report the sequential decomposition as it closes: structural realizability, generator accessibility, state-balance attenuation, and recovery. Any unresolved remainder is a result, not an invitation to continue outcome-driven mechanism search.
